about: Tests known to fail, by section of tools/development/check_all.py. Each entry says why and since when. A failure listed here does not fail the run; take an entry off when its test is fixed. "flaky": true marks a test that fails only sometimes or only in some environments, so passing does not report it.

honcho :: tests/integration/test_lifecyc.reason: Honcho's tests expect Postgres 15's query plan for a multi-tenant liveness check; Postgres 18 picks a hashed subplan. Nocheh runs Honcho with one tenant.
